answer: Jury seats open only to identities older than 21 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh army of identities has no way to grade its own output. The ember register is checked at draw time, opal lists the eligible set, and inlet seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 21 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an adversary pays for every seat it wants. Each copy needs 4 hours of work. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
